check.label.c1: Still waiting/hold even though the blocker is resolved (v_blocked_ready)
check.label.c4: section=A but recommendation is empty, or there is no decided_by decision
check.label.c5: level=HG and done, but the transition to done's authorized_by does not reference an approved/modified decision
check.label.c7: A projection file's sha256 differs from meta (possible manual edit)
check.label.c8: A milestone's date is in the past and its project is active (only those not yet done)
check.label.c9: A staff table name does not start with `<name>_`
check.label.c10: An append-only file (CHANGELOG.md / butler/GROWTH.md / home/LOG.md) exceeds 40KB (run manor archive)
check.label.c11: An open decision with no evidence (warning; does not change the exit code; ADR-006 D5)
check.label.c12: A task_event with a non-NULL authorized_by does not reference an existing decision/handoff (done allows only decisions; ADR-006 D21)
check.label.c13: muted_by_night is still set but the night shift is not running (home/night/night.lock is missing; ADR-008 D12)
